_about: Step 3i goal library: the offence's goals and the defence's objectives, from GOAL_LIBRARY.md. Edit freely: words, levels and answers are data. 'pattern' names the code that reads the board for a goal (planner.py); 'variant' picks its form. built=false entries are listed with the reason.

offence.name: Post entry
offence.words: O{p} in the post on X{d}
offence.edge: a ▲ post scorer against a ▼ post contest
conditions: the post player holds a seal on their defender
a passer has a clean entry lane
the passer has the ball
chain: swing to the side with the clean angle if needed (A1a)
offence.finish: a post shot, or a kick-out if help comes
answers: front the post (gives up the lob or a high-low)
dig with a guard (gives up the kick-out)

offence.name: Re-entry angle
offence.words: O{p} in the post from the far side
offence.edge: the post is fronted on one side
conditions: each swing pass is clean (the receivers move first)
the re-seal from the far side
a clean entry lane
chain: receivers move to open the lanes

offence.name: High-low
offence.edge: a post player sealing low and a teammate at the high post who can pass
conditions: the high player has the ball
the low player holds a seal on the side away from him
the lane between them is clean
offence.finish: a post shot or a layup
answers: front low (gives up a lob, or the high player's shot)
sink the high player's defender (gives up his mid-range)

offence.name: Isolation
offence.edge: the carrier's Dribble beats an adjacent defender's Agility with a shot past him
conditions: the carrier is adjacent to the defender
help is spent or far
space beyond the arrow line
answers: help early (gives up the helper's player)
load to the ball side (gives up the weak-side three)

offence.name: Spot-up three
offence.words: O{s} spots up for a three
offence.edge: a ▲ three-point shooter with his defender out of clean reach
conditions: the shooter is on a three square
a clean lane to him
no clean contest reachable in the reaction
answers: stay home (gives up the drive or the post)
top-lock or deny (gives up the back cut)

offence.name: Mid-range in the gap
offence.words: O{c} pulls up in the gap off O{sc}'s screen
offence.edge: the carrier's ▲ mid-range or floater
conditions: the carrier reaches a mid-range square with only a Behind or foul-roll contest
answers: at the level or hedge (gives up the roll)

offence.name: V-cut
offence.edge: a receiver's defender who will follow
conditions: the defender spent his Move following in, or stays and gives up the inside
chain: Move out to the catch spot (next phase)
offence.finish: a clean pass to the receiver
answers: don't follow, sag (gives up the inside cut)
follow and recover next phase (spends the Move)

offence.name: L-cut
offence.edge: as B1, at the elbow or wing
conditions: as B1

offence.name: Backdoor cut
offence.edge: a defender whose arrow faces the ball or the lane
conditions: a path behind that defender to the rim zone
a lane to it he can't answer
chain: Move or Sprint behind him to the rim
answers: play off the catch (gives up a clean catch)
help-side tag at the rim (gives up the helper's player)

offence.name: Dribble-at backdoor
offence.edge: the carrier moves at an overplaying defender, pushing him back
offence.not_built: A carrier's move can't push a defender back: defenders move only on their own turn. The plain backdoor (B3) covers the cut.

offence.name: Shift away
offence.edge: a ▲ three-point shooter whose defender is the nearest help on the ball
conditions: the defender must choose between following and helping
chain: Move the shooter away along the arc
offence.finish: the ball attacks the help job, or the shooter catches
answers: a rotation that hands one job to a defender with capacity left

offence.name: Baseline cut
offence.edge: a defender who must chase through traffic
conditions: at the end the chaser is Behind or facing away
chain: Move along the baseline under the rim
Move out to the far corner next phase
offence.finish: a corner three, or a layup
answers: switch or bump the cutter (gives up that defender's player)

offence.name: Give and go
offence.words: O{c} gives and goes with O{r}
offence.edge: the passer's defender relaxes after the pass
conditions: a path in front of him to the rim
chain: Move to the rim next turn
offence.finish: a return pass and a layup
answers: jump to the ball (spends a Move)

offence.name: Shallow cut
offence.edge: the carrier needs the side cleared
chain: Move inside the carrier, out to the corner or wing
offence.finish: space, or a clean safety pass

offence.name: 45 cut into the gap
offence.edge: the help-side defender is occupied
chain: Move into the gap behind the defence
offence.finish: a layup or floater from a pass
answers: the low man rotates (gives up the weak-side corner)

offence.name: Veer cut
offence.edge: a defender who reacts to approach

offence.name: Drain the closeout
offence.edge: a ▲ shooter with exactly one defender able to close out cleanly
conditions: that defender's Move is spent, or the pool can't reach
chain: reversals, cuts or drives that make him spend

offence.name: Two-job defender
offence.words: X{d} has two jobs: O{s} or the drive
offence.edge: one defender is the only answer to two threats
conditions: the offence can attack either threat after the defence chooses
chain: B4 or B5 to create it
attack the job the reply leaves
offence.finish: a drive, or the shooter's shot
answers: a rotation that hands one job to a defender with capacity left

offence.name: Drive and kick
offence.edge: the carrier's drive pulls help off a ▲ shooter
conditions: the helper has committed
the kick lane is clean
chain: A3 or D1 to the paint
an extra pass if the closeout rotates
answers: X-out rotation (needs two defenders with capacity)

offence.name: Skip pass
offence.edge: the defence has shrunk to the ball side
conditions: a clean lane to the weak side over the top
chain: receivers move first to open the lane
answers: the weak-side defender plays the lane (gives up his man's cut)

offence.name: Overload one side
offence.edge: more threats on one side than defenders who can reach them
chain: move three attackers to one side
offence.finish: an open player on that side, or a skip
answers: zone the far side (gives up the skip)

offence.name: Pick and roll
offence.words: O{sc} screens X{d} for O{c} and rolls
offence.edge: a carrier who can attack and a screener who finishes at the rim
conditions: the screen holds on the carrier's defender, or he beats it and loses position
chain: screener next to the carrier's defender
offence.finish: the carrier's shot, the pass to the roller, or a kick

offence.name: Pick and pop
offence.words: O{sc} screens for O{c} and pops
offence.edge: a screener with ▲ three or long two
chain: as D1, the screener to the arc

offence.name: Slip
offence.edge: the screener's defender commits early
chain: instead of screening, to the rim
answers: a weak-side tag at the rim

offence.name: Ghost screen
offence.edge: as D3, for a popping shooter

offence.name: Spain pick and roll
offence.edge: a D1 position where the roller's defender drops
chain: a second Screen by a third player on the dropping defender
offence.finish: the roll, or the back-screener popping

offence.name: Re-screen
offence.edge: the on-ball defender beat the first screen

offence.name: Handoff
offence.edge: a receiver who attacks off the catch, and a passer whose piece blocks the chaser
conditions: the passer is adjacent to the receiver
the short lane is clean
the passer's square lies across the chaser's path
chain: the receiver moves past the passer
offence.finish: a drive, a pull-up or a three

offence.name: Screen to switch
offence.words: O{sc} screens X{d} to switch X{d2} onto O{c}
offence.edge: the switch leaves a ▼ defender on a ▲ attacker
conditions: the screen holds or forces the other defender to pick up
the attacker has the matching edge

offence.name: Off-ball screen
offence.edge: a ▲ shooter or cutter whose defender can be screened
conditions: the screen holds or diverts him, so the cutter catches before a clean contest
chain: Screen with the T on the cutter's defender
answers: chase over the top (Challenge, a Move, the facing)

offence.name: Off-ball screen: down screen
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: pin-down
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: flare
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: back screen
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: UCLA
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: stagger
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: double
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: floppy
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: cross screen
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: zipper
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: corner pin
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Off-ball screen: screen the screener
offence.words: screen the screener: O{sc} for O{r}
offence.edge: as E2

offence.name: Speed against slow feet
offence.edge: Quick Step 2 against a defender with Quick Step 0
chain: a Sprint or a straight-line burst to a square he can't reach

offence.name: Late clock
offence.edge: one phase left
offence.finish: only goals that finish now rank

offence.name: Need a Three
offence.edge: the card
offence.finish: only goals that finish in a three score

offence.name: Coach's Call
offence.edge: the card
offence.finish: the target's goals carry the card's bonus

offence.name: Inbounds
offence.edge: an inbound
offence.finish: the first pass: B1, B2, B3 or E2 into a clean lane

defence.gives_up: a Steal foul, the drive past

defence.words: keep the ball out of O{p}'s post

_roles: role: 'finish' goals are valued by their own finish (the shot after the defence's reaction, from the expected board once their steps are played); 'setup' goals have no value of their own: P(their rolls) x what the offence keeps on the board they leave, after the defence denies the most dangerous finish they unlock, less the steps' cost.
